review.assessment: This change replaces the `NotImplementedError` placeholder with a greedy line-wrapping implementation that splits input text by whitespace, accumulates words onto lines until adding another would exceed the width limit, and appends remaining or overflow words to new lines. It correctly enforces the maximum line length constraint (allowing single words longer than `width` to occupy their own line), normalizes arbitrary spacing between words, and safely handles empty or whitespace-only inputs without raising errors. The logic is sound, covers all stated requirements, and introduces no regressions.
